Cost of raw material = 4x

Expenditure costs = 3x

Miscellaneous costs = 2x

Total cost = 4x + 3x + 2x = 9x

Amount = (4x * 110) / 100 + (3x * 108) / 100 + (2x * 95) / 100

= 9.54x

Percentage rise = (9.54x - 9x) / 9x * 100 = 6%

questions.q:
64% of the first's number equals 70% of the second's number. If the second number is increased by 960 and the first number is decreased by 200, then the ratio of the second number to the first number becomes 6: 5. What is the value of the first number?

पहली संख्या का 64% दूसरी संख्या के 70% के बराबर है। यदि दूसरी संख्या में 960 की वृद्धि की जाए तथा पहली संख्या में 200 की कमी की जाए, तो दूसरी संख्या का पहली संख्या से अनुपात 6:5 हो जाता है। पहली संख्या का मान क्या है?
questions.s:
The first number * 64/100 = the second number * 70/100

The first number/ The second number = 35/32

Let the first number and the second number be '35X' and '32X' respectively.

A/Q

(The second number + 960)/ (The first number - 200) = 6/5

(32X + 960)/ (35X - 200) = 6/5

160X + 4800 = 210X - 1200

50X = 6000

X = 120

Hence, the first number = 35 * 120 = 4200
